claim_boundary: E88 is a benchmark manifest over public AgentDojo tasks and attacks. It is not a corpus of deployed attacks, does not contain raw injection text, and does not establish production safety.
intended_use: Sandboxed research evaluation of indirect-instruction robustness and pre-commit mediation.
payload_resolution: Fixed attack text and injection goals are resolved from the pinned local AgentDojo public registry at execution.
scoring: Official environment validators; no LLM security judge.
